name: Cascader
summary: Options in levels, opened one level at a time. Every level is a disclosure, so the browser does the opening and the closing and the state survives a reload.
summaryZh: 分层的选项,一次展开一层。每一层都是一个展开控件,所以开关由浏览器负责,展开的状态也能扛过一次刷新。

variants.name: Inline
variants.note: The level below opens under the option it hangs off, and a rule marks where the branch begins. The base class on its own is this layout, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Flyout
variants.note: The level below opens beside the one it hangs off, as a floating column over the page.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The option text takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The option text takes the title size.

states.name: Open
states.note: The level is open. The browser announces it, and the arrow turns over in the inline run.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the option, because the option is what the reader is on.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The level cannot be opened, so the pointer is refused and the text takes the derived disabled colour.

states.name: Clearable
states.note: The field carries the mark that clears the choice.

states.name: Collapse tags
states.note: Only the first chip is shown, so the field keeps one line. How many were folded is the host's to say.

states.name: Filterable
states.note: The field carries the input the host filters the levels with.

states.name: Fit input width
states.note: The panel that opens beside the option takes the width of the field rather than the width of its own options.

states.name: Virtual scroll
states.note: The levels far from the reader are not laid out: the browser gives them a placeholder size instead, so the scrollbar is right without every level being built.

states.name: Dark effect
states.note: The component's own surface is filled with the brand colour.

states.name: Plain effect
states.note: The component's own surface drops the fill.

states.name: Tag in success
states.note: The chips take the success colour.

states.name: Tag in warning
states.note: The chips take the warning colour.

states.name: Tag in danger
states.note: The chips take the danger colour.

states.name: Tag in info
states.note: The chips take the neutral information colour.

states.name: Tag effect dark
states.note: The chips are a solid fill in the colour their type names.

states.name: Tag effect plain
states.note: The chips are an outline in the colour their type names, with no fill.

parts.name: Panel
parts.note: One level of the cascader. It is a <details>, and it is the element that knows whether it is open.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: One option in a level. It is the <summary>, so it is focusable and the browser toggles it.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The mark that says the option has a level below it. It is drawn from two borders, so it carries no text of its own.

parts.name: Children
parts.note: The level below an option. It holds the next set of options, each of which is a panel of its own.

parts.name: Field
parts.note: The row above the levels: it holds the prefix, the chips that show the choice, the filter and the clear mark. It takes no room when the host has asked for none of them.

parts.name: Prefix
parts.note: The mark that stands in front of the control. It is the host's own, so the library draws no glyph of its own.

parts.name: Tags
parts.note: The row of chips that shows the choice.

parts.name: Tag
parts.note: One chip. It holds one chosen value, and the type and the effect say how it is painted.

parts.name: Filter
parts.note: The input the host filters the levels with. It is a real search field, so the filtering is the host's script.

parts.name: Clear
parts.note: The mark that clears the choice. It is drawn from two bars, so it carries no text of its own, and it is a real button so the keyboard can reach it.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: What stands above the levels: a note, a heading.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: What stands below the levels: a note, a count.

parts.name: Empty
parts.note: What a level says when it holds no option at all.

props.name: open
props.description: Opens a level. It is the native open attribute on the details, so the browser keeps the state.
props.descriptionZh: 展开某一层。它是 details 上的原生 open 属性,所以状态由浏览器记着。

props.name: layout
props.description: Where the level below opens. The inline run is the base class on its own; the flyout run adds um-cascader--flyout.
props.descriptionZh: 下一层往哪里开。内联是只写基础类;浮层再加上 um-cascader--flyout。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the option text.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of one option. An option with no text needs an accessible name of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 某一个选项的文字。没有文字的选项也得有自己的可访问名称。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the cascader inert. A level is a disclosure rather than a form control, so it cannot carry the disabled attribute: the whole tree refuses the pointer instead.
props.descriptionZh: 让级联选择器不可用。每一层是一个 disclosure 而不是表单控件,所以带不了 disabled 属性:整棵树改为拒绝指针。

props.name: clearable
props.description: Whether the field carries the mark that clears the choice. It adds um-cascader--clearable.
props.descriptionZh: 输入区上是否带那个清空选择的记号。它加上 um-cascader--clearable。

props.name: collapse-tags
props.description: Whether only the first chip is shown, so the field keeps one line. How many were folded is the host's to say. It adds um-cascader--collapse-tags.
props.descriptionZh: 是不是只显示第一个标签,于是输入区只占一行。折叠了几个是宿主自己的事。它加上 um-cascader--collapse-tags。

props.name: effect
props.description: How the component's own surface is painted. The light effect is the surface the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the dark effect adds um-cascader--effect-dark and the plain effect adds um-cascader--effect-plain.
props.descriptionZh: 组件自己的底面怎么画。浅色效果就是库画的这个底面,不需要修饰类;深色效果加上 um-cascader--effect-dark,朴素效果加上 um-cascader--effect-plain。

props.name: filterable
props.description: Whether the field carries the input the host filters the levels with. The input is a real search field, so the filtering is the host's script and the library only draws it. It adds um-cascader--filterable.
props.descriptionZh: 输入区上是否带上那个供宿主筛选各层的输入框。这个输入框是真的搜索框,所以筛选是宿主脚本的事,库只负责画它。它加上 um-cascader--filterable。

props.name: fit-input-width
props.description: Whether the panel that opens beside an option takes the width of the field rather than the width of its own options. It adds um-cascader--fit-input-width.
props.descriptionZh: 在选项旁边打开的那一层是否取输入区的宽度,而不是由它自己的选项撑出来的宽度。它加上 um-cascader--fit-input-width。

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The hint in the filter field. It is the native placeholder attribute on the input, so the browser paints it in the muted placeholder role.
props.descriptionZh: 筛选输入框里的提示文字。它是 input 上的原生 placeholder 属性,所以浏览器会用弱化的占位文字色画它。

props.name: tag-type
props.description: Which colour the chips take. The primary colour is the one the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the other four add um-cascader--tag-success, um-cascader--tag-warning, um-cascader--tag-danger and um-cascader--tag-info.
props.descriptionZh: 标签取什么颜色。主色是库画的那个,不需要修饰类;另外四个分别加上 um-cascader--tag-success、um-cascader--tag-warning、um-cascader--tag-danger 和 um-cascader--tag-info。

props.name: tag-effect
props.description: How the chips are painted: a tint, a solid fill or an outline with no fill. The tint is the one the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the solid fill adds um-cascader--tag-effect-dark and the outline adds um-cascader--tag-effect-plain.
props.descriptionZh: 标签怎么画:淡底、实底,还是没有底色的描边。淡底是库画的那个,不需要修饰类;实底加上 um-cascader--tag-effect-dark,描边加上 um-cascader--tag-effect-plain。

props.name: virtual-scroll
props.description: Whether the levels far from the reader are left out of the layout. The browser is told how tall such a level is, so the scrollbar is right without every level being built. It adds um-cascader--virtual-scroll.
props.descriptionZh: 离读者很远的那些层是否不参与排版。浏览器会被告知这种层有多高,所以不用把每一层都建出来,滚动条也是对的。它加上 um-cascader--virtual-scroll。

slots.name: option
slots.description: One option: its text and the mark that says there is a level below it.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个选项:它的文字,以及那个表示下面还有一层的记号。

slots.name: children
slots.description: The level below, holding one option per branch.
slots.descriptionZh: 下面那一层,每个分支放一个选项。

slots.name: default
slots.description: One option: its text and the mark that says there is a level below it. It is the name Element Plus gives the same content the option slot fills.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个选项:它的文字,以及那个表示下面还有一层的记号。它是 Element Plus 给 option 插槽所填的同一份内容起的名字。

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: The mark that stands in front of the control. It is the host's own, so the library draws no glyph of its own.
slots.descriptionZh: 控件前面的记号。它是宿主自己的,所以库不画任何字形。

slots.name: tag
slots.description: What one chip says. It is given the chosen value and the chip's number. Without it the chip is empty, and an empty chip is not drawn.
slots.descriptionZh: 某一个标签写什么。它拿到选中的值和这个标签的序号。不给就空着,而空着的标签不画出来。

slots.name: header
slots.description: What stands above the levels: a note, a heading.
slots.descriptionZh: 各层上面放什么:一句说明,或者一个小标题。

slots.name: footer
slots.description: What stands below the levels: a note, a count.
slots.descriptionZh: 各层下面放什么:一句说明,或者一个计数。

slots.name: empty
slots.description: What a level says when it holds no option at all.
slots.descriptionZh: 某一层一个选项都没有的时候说什么。

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires when a level opens or closes. It is the browser's own event on the details — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 某一层展开或收起时触发。这是 details 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: clear
events.description: Fires when the clear mark is pressed. The value that follows is the empty one, and the host writes it back.
events.descriptionZh: 按下清空记号时触发。接下来的值是空值,由宿主写回去。

a11y.notes: Every level is a real <details> and every option is a real <summary>, so the browser announces each option as a disclosure button and says whether its level is open. The keyboard is the browser's own: Tab reaches the options, Enter or Space opens the level below. The arrow is drawn from borders, so it carries no text — the level below is announced by the browser, not by the mark. A library with no JavaScript cannot work out the chosen path, so the path a reader has picked is the host's to write.
a11y.notesZh: 每一层都是真正的 <details>,每一个选项都是真正的 <summary>,所以浏览器会把每个选项播报成展开按钮,并说明它那一层是开着还是关着。键盘也是浏览器自己的:Tab 走到选项上,Enter 或空格展开下面那层。那个箭头是边框画出来的,所以它自己不带文字 —— 下面还有一层这件事是浏览器说的,不是那个记号说的。没有 JavaScript 的库算不出读者选中的那条路径,所以选中的路径由宿主来写。

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: Three levels. Opening an option opens the level below it under the option, and a rule marks where the branch begins. Only the modifier class would change this.
examples.descriptionZh: 三层。展开一个选项,下面那一层就在它底下打开,一条线标出分支从哪里开始。只改修饰类的话就是这个样子。

examples.title: Flyout
examples.description: The same levels, with the level below opening beside the one it hangs off. The first level is open, so the second one is already showing.
examples.descriptionZh: 同样的层级,只是下面那层开在旁边而不是下面。第一层是开着的,所以第二层已经露出来了。
examples.markup:
Asia
China
Beijing

notes: A level is a disclosure, not a menu: the browser owns the open state, so the branch stays open across a reload and the reader gets the "collapsed" and "expanded" announcement for free. The level below is hidden with `display: none` and shown again by `[open]`, because in the flyout run the panel is taken out of the flow and the browser's own hiding is not guaranteed to catch that. The mark that says there is a level below is drawn from two borders, so it takes the option's own colour.
notesZh: 一层是一个展开控件,不是一个菜单:开关状态归浏览器管,所以分支在刷新之后还是开着的,读者也能免费得到「已折叠」「已展开」的播报。下面那一层是用 `display: none` 藏起来的,再由 `[open]` 放出来,因为在浮层这一跑里面板是被拿出文档流的,浏览器自己的隐藏不保证能盖住它。那个表示下面还有一层的记号是用两条边框画出来的,所以它跟着选项自己的颜色走。
